subject: Commit-guard experiment late staged-store failure and production backend applicability
verdict: Native fixture correction justified; rollback acceptance remains failed until new exact-source execution. Application IndexedDB qualification remains open.

observations.failure: Late staged-store exception: events.length expected 0, actual 1. Parent suite also failed.
observations.notesAfterFailure: Not independently observed; note-count assertion follows failed event-count assertion.

sourceFindings.finding: Actual experiment opens legacy AztecLmdbStore from kv-store/lmdb. Its transactionAsync forwards to rootDb.transaction(callback), which selects transactionAsync without asChild. The non-child callback catch records CALLBACK_THREW without env.abortTxn. This explains why callback rejection need not roll back earlier writes.

Official native PXE server selects persistent openStoreAt or ephemeral openTmpStore from lmdb-v2 only when options.store is absent. v2 transactionAsync awaits callback before WriteTransaction.commit; writes remain in data/index batches until the successful BATCH operation. A thrown later staged-store callback skips commit.

Rolling browser wallet-session and CLI application actor explicitly provide sdk.openPXEStore; shared/sdk-store.mjs selects deprecated IndexedDB. They bypass the official native default. IndexedDB transactionAsync awaits tx.done before awaiting callback result and has no explicit callback-failure abort. Therefore v2 experiment cannot establish atomic failure rollback for actual Rolling storage.

requiredNext: Keep original failed run unchanged; change only experiment backend setup to official native v2 and bind exact new source.
Retain both event and note zero-write assertions after late staged-store failure, all settlement/context/canonical guards, positive utility and reorg pruning checks.
Run only after a separate bounded native slot grant; close/delete owned stores and preserve original errors.
Before application integration, independently reproduce and establish rollback on the actual deprecated IndexedDB path; native v2 success does not close this requirement.
limits: Read-only source diagnosis; no native or browser execution by reviewer.
Does not claim all legacy transaction forms fail rollback; diagnosis applies to the inspected non-child path.
Does not qualify full preference recovery, cold completeness, actual chain membership or release.
